answer: Each epoch the payout rides a caravan across the dune, and a claim boards only if a raven — a stranger courier drawn by the beacon — carries its cipher waybill through three waystations, each stamping one distinct job done this epoch. Waybills cut from one funding trail carry the same cipher seal, so that trail gets one seat: n clones arrive with n waybills yet share one seat and one payout. A raven catching two waybills with the same seal burns both bonds and keeps a bounty, so a farm pays n couriers, n job chains and n bonds for one seat, while one honest agent pays once.
